name: 残页·星卷
text: 每场战斗你第一次打出延时牌时，立即进行一次[判定]：阳纹——对随机敌人造成8点伤害；阴纹——获得8点[护甲]。
flavor: 星卷不写命数，只写命数来临之前的那一瞬。

art.subject: a torn scroll page covered in tiny dotted constellations, one star flaring bright as it falls off the page

name: 狐母的绒球
text: 战斗开始时，获得4层[再生]。
flavor: 她给你的时候笑得很温柔。你最好别问是谁的毛。

art.subject: a soft round ball of white fox fur tied with a red bell string, faintly glowing warm pink, on a mossy stone

name: 溺王的金冠
text: 你的主帅造成的攻击伤害+2。每回合开始时，失去1点生命。
flavor: 冠很重。戴着它的人，每天都在往下沉一点。

art.subject: a tall golden king's crown half sunk in black water, water streaming from its jewels, reflection distorted

name: 司命遗墨
text: 拾取时，向天命牌堆加入2张{sun}日纹13与2张{mountain}山纹13。
flavor: 司命写错的几笔，被你偷偷描了回去。

art.subject: a dried pool of luminous gold ink on an ancient desk, four fresh cards painted from it, a brush left mid-stroke

name: 双生判官的铜钱
text: 每当你[改判]，对随机敌人造成5点伤害。
flavor: 正面判生，反面判死。它从来只落在侧面。

art.subject: an old bronze coin spinning on its edge, one face with a smiling judge and the other a frowning judge, dim courtroom

name: 守墓人的铁铲
text: 每当一个敌方单位死亡，战斗后额外获得3金。
flavor: 埋人的活，总得有人收钱。

art.subject: a worn iron grave spade planted in fresh earth beside a leaning tombstone, a few coins glinting in the dirt

name: 逆命之契
text: 每回合可以额外献牌为源1次。每当你献牌为源，失去2点生命。
flavor: 契约上写着：多给你一次，也多收你一次。

art.subject: a scroll contract signed in blood with a burning thumbprint, dark red wax seal cracking open, smoke curling

name: 王庭钥匙
text: 拾取时，获得1件随机稀有遗物，并将1张「宿业」加入牌组。
flavor: 地下王庭的宝库只有一扇门，门后还站着看守的东西。

art.subject: a large ornate bronze key with a crown-shaped bow, a faint dark aura clinging to its teeth, on a velvet cushion
